In the darkest and most trying hour God is near.<div eID="gen8679" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen8680" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">the valley of the shadow of death--</hi>is a ravine overhung by high precipitous cliffs, filled with dense forests, and well calculated to inspire dread to the timid, and afford a covert to beasts of prey. entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5705"/><div sID="gen8682" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5705"/>5-6. Another figure expresses God's provided care.<div eID="gen8682" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen8683" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">a table--</hi>or, "food," anointing<div eID="gen8683" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen8684" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">oil--</hi>the symbol of gladness, and the overflowing<div eID="gen8684" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen8685" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">cup--</hi>which represents abundance--are prepared for the child of God, who may feast in spite of his enemies, confident that this favor will ever attend him. This beautiful Psalm most admirably sets before us, in its chief figure, that of a shepherd, the gentle, kind, and sure care extended to God's people, who, as a shepherd, both rules and feeds them. The closing verse shows that the blessings mentioned are spiritual. <chapter eID="Ps.23"/>
entries.content_plain: 5-6. Another figure expresses God's provided care. a table-- or, "food," anointing oil-- the symbol of gladness, and the overflowing cup-- which represents abundance--are prepared for the child of God, who may feast in spite of his enemies, confident that this favor will ever attend him.
